verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly anticipate CI use through a dedicated CI API key, SDKs for automating workflows, and scorer pass thresholds. That gives a product-native way to run evals from CI and get pass/fail results, but no documented mechanism actually gates deployments on them. Missing for 10: a documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action or CLI), a deployment-gating workflow (exit codes or status checks on failed thresholds), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
